parameters.name: CheckJobStatus
parameters.description: Specifies whether to check the job status. Valid values: -**true**: The job can be run only if the job is enabled. -**false**: The job can be run even if the job is disabled.

parameters.name: DesignateType
parameters.description: The type of the designated machine. Valid values: -**1**: worker. -**2**: label.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can obtain the application ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: InstanceParameters
parameters.description: The parameters that are passed to trigger the job to run. The input value can be a random string. The parameters that are passed are obtained by calling the `context.getInstanceParameters()` class in the `processor` code. The parameters are different from custom parameters for creating jobs.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The job ID. You can obtain the job ID on the Task Management page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

parameters.name: Worker
parameters.description: The worker address of the application. To query the worker address, call the GetWokerList operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 execute-job --job-id 92583 --instance-parameters test --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --check-job-status true --designate-type 1 --worker xxxxxxx@127.0.0.1:222 --label gray --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 ExecuteJob --region cn-hangzhou --DesignateType 1 --CheckJobStatus true --NamespaceSource schedulerx --Label gray --InstanceParameters test --Worker 'xxxxxxx@127.0.0.1:222' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --JobId 92583 --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --GroupId 'testSchedulerx.defaultGroup'
